item.title: Pope warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity as he opens France trip
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has warned that a "paradise of machines" could undermine humanity. He raises concerns about artificial intelligence, nuclear arms, and human rights during his visit to France.

item.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump-backed Missouri congressional map
item.description: The ruling is a defeat for Republicans seeking to give their party an edge in the midterms for control of the House. It means voters will face a different map than the one used in the primaries.

item.title: The Pacific is churning with hurricanes. The Atlantic is quiet. Blame El Niño
item.description: The Pacific Ocean has had an unusual number of storms this year, while the Atlantic hasn't recorded a single full-blown hurricane. Scientists point to an exceptionally strong El Niño.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: The Supreme Court revives a controversial data system for citizenship checks
item.description: The Supreme Court is allowing use of a data system that Trump officials overhauled. The system has erroneously flagged U.S. citizens and a lower court found it violated federal privacy protections.
